fusions.name: Fault Line
fusions.desc: Stamps and splits the ground along a narrow path 5 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Landslide
fusions.desc: Charges up to 6 tiles at the first enemy in line and strikes for 30 damage. The impact throws up rock that deals 80% of that damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Ground Shudder
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground and holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hard Going
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
